title: Prove rank-three mask attribution through five active stages
body:
A rank-three formal endpoint identity through five active stages has a global mask partition in the stated field range. All 828 enumerated five-stage nonpartitions fail exact projector constraints.

## Scope and source

Extends #7941 using characteristic zero or greater than three and the complete formal polynomial identity. The literal five-stage irreducible control has even q targets and no HOSTs. The source extension is #7869 at `06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-qzero-five-stage-attribution/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. The corrected archive’s full cold replay regenerated the census and all 33 strengthened certificates. An independent integer checker confirms explicit row and column deductions, including rejection of a missing-row mutation. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Address more stages or the distinct tight odd-HOST and strict-support obligations.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
